t: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 2
d: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On the Case.

t: On the Case: This is for Her
d: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

After Navy electrician Michael Jacobs comes home to find his wife, Suzanne, and his three-year-old son, Colin, murdered, San Diego police race to catch a serial killer who leaves behind an unimaginable calling card.

t: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
d: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.
After 21 years, DNA analysis of a blood-stained dollar bill helps to solve the murder of gas station clerk Bradley Perry.
A family of three is murdered and investigators must take on one of their own in order to find justice.

t: On the Case: The Killer Rang Twice
d: Linda Donahew, of Arlington Texas, was discovered stabbed to death by her sister one night in June. For nearly two decades the case remained unsolved, until detectives matched DNA from Linda's case with another case a few hundred miles away.

t: On the Case: Footsteps in the Dark
d: A beautiful young woman's is murdered in a dark parking lot. Did she know her killer or was she the victim of a deadly predator?

t: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
d: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

t: On the Case: Mystery, Heartbreak and Justice
d: A look at three cases in which the quest for justice rages on after the verdict has been delivered.

t: On the Case: Same Crime Next Year
d: A teenager is found murdered on the weekend of the Daytona 500 motor race in Daytona Beach, Florida. Then, one year later, police are called to the scene of a nearly identical crime.

t: On the Case: The Doorbell Rang
d: The ring of a doorbell overheard during a teenager's final telephone call may be the key to solving her murder.

t: On the Case: Over The Edge
d: Police are called to the scene of what appears to be a tragic car wreck in the Blue Ridge Mountains... But as Investigators examine the crash site they realize Wendy Kratzert's death was no accident.

t: On the Case: A Stranger's Knock
d: When firefighters respond to a house fire they discover a woman shot and killed inside.  Police must unlock the mystery of who started the blaze to solve the murder.

t: On the Case: Hanging By A Thread
d: Hillsborough County Florida is in the midst of a horrifying crime spree. Young women are turning up dead every week. Can one teen age girl's bravery bring an end to a vicious killer's reign of terror?

t: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
d: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

t: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
d: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

t: On the Case: A Killer in the Sun
d: When Kenny Baker returns home, the backdoor is ajar and his wife, Kathy, and two-year-old son, Ryan, are nowhere to be found.

t: On the Case: A Fateful Decision
d: A Young mother is kidnapped out of her driveway after a birthday celebration... Did a string of good luck, lead to her disappearance.
